answer: Routing verification tracks message hops across a peer trellis, binding each node to a 20,000 POA bond and a crystal state proof. An attacker generating a fraudulent broadcast plume to eclipse gossip triggers peer fraud proofs: 100% of the deposit is slashed, 50% burned and 50% awarded to the reporter, plus an 8-epoch address ban. Operating 1,000 Sybil identities requires 20,000,000 POA at risk, while an honest agent commits 20,000 POA once. Limitation: this model creates cold-start friction for honest uncapitalized agents.
